description: Dual-service Flask+Django URL shortener with click analytics, custom and secret links, and auto-expiry. The Flask REST API in pygmy/ is called by the Django UI in pygmyui/. The key contains five attacker-reachable vulnerabilities seeded into real application features. Reproduction steps are in POC.md.

vulnerabilities.description: The "search my links" endpoint's `q` parameter is concatenated directly into a raw SQL LIKE clause instead of being passed as a bound parameter. The injection also breaks out of the surrounding `owner = ...` filter, exposing other users' links, not just bypassing the keyword match.
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: Allows an authenticated user to read other users' shortened links (long_url, short_code) by breaking out of both the keyword filter and the per-owner scoping.

vulnerabilities.description: The links-export download endpoint joins a request-controlled `filename` parameter onto the user's export directory with no containment check before opening it, allowing `../` sequences to escape the intended per-user folder.
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: Allows an authenticated user to read arbitrary files on the server outside the exports folder.

vulnerabilities.description: The click-analytics reverse-DNS lookup tool (abuse investigation on a link's traffic) passes the `host` query parameter directly into a `host` shell command with shell=True, with no escaping or validation.
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: Allows an authenticated user to break out of the intended command via shell metacharacters and execute arbitrary OS commands with the privileges of the server process.

vulnerabilities.description: The advanced link-filter endpoint evaluates the caller-supplied `expression` with Python's eval(), passing only a local-variable context dict that does not restrict access to builtins.
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: Allows an authenticated user to execute arbitrary Python code, and via __import__, arbitrary OS commands, on the server.

vulnerabilities.description: Before shortening a new link, the server verifies the submitted `long_url` is reachable by making a server-side HTTP request to it, with no allowlist or restriction on the target host.
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: Allows an attacker to make the server issue arbitrary outbound HTTP requests, including to internal-only services not otherwise reachable from outside the network.
